Tooltip_MinidoracatAutoDrive_GPS: How to use: keep it in your inventory with a battery, open the world map and pick a destination to plan a route along the roads. Optional: stand next to a vehicle and right-click it to install the navigator (needs a screwdriver, a vehicle battery and Electrical 1).
Tooltip_MinidoracatAutoDrive_Auto: How to use: stand next to a vehicle, right-click it and choose "Install Autopilot Module" (needs a screwdriver, a vehicle battery and Electrical 1). Then plan a route with a GPS Navigator, sit in the driver's seat and press "Engage Autodrive" on the panel above the dashboard.
